# REFERENCE STACK — MV-25 (autogenerated per project, built 2026-11-20 before volley 1)

All refs generated in-project (media.generate_image), 16:9, warm photoreal, zero text. Character refs READ BACK and verified by eye before use (husband: greying temples, rust-red crewneck, round friendly face — matches lock; wife: dark wavy low ponytail, deep-green blouse, cream apron, serving spoon — matches lock).

| Ref | File | md5 | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|
| REF_HUSBAND | work/stills/stack/REF_HUSBAND.png | see md5sum log in work/qc/ref_md5.txt | every HUSBAND singing take (character anchor, first image) |
| REF_WIFE | work/stills/stack/REF_WIFE.png | " | every WIFE take |
| REF_DINING | work/stills/stack/REF_DINING.png | " | dining-room scenes (world conditioner) |
| REF_KITCHEN | work/stills/stack/REF_KITCHEN.png | " | kitchen scenes |

Chaining: within a section, take N+1 conditions on take N's last frame (extracted to work/stills/chain/) as second image where the plan holds framing; fresh starts use the scene's own ref pair. Never chain from a rejected take.
Per-scene start/end pairs are derived from the refs above + chain frames as the build proceeds; each vehicle names its refs.
